name: ascii-canvas
description: A production-grade ASCII diagram editor built with Rust and WebAssembly
author: d-o-hub

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:web
scripts.netlify:build: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.126 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd .. && pnpm run build && pnpm run check-size
scripts.lint:web: cd web && pnpm run lint && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check-size: size=$(stat -c%s web/pkg/ascii_canvas_bg.wasm); if [ $size -gt 1572864 ]; then echo "WASM size $size exceeds 1.5MB limit"; exit 1; else echo "WASM size $size is within budget"; fi
